The '''Delphania system''' was located in the [[Esuain sector/Legends|Esuain sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Delphanian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="DeathTroopers" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Delphania [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-7.<ref name="TEA" />
